#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

static int32_t c_visitor_visitor_definition_list_custom_visit_definition_term(const HTMHtmContext* _ctx, void* _user_data, const char* _text, char** out_custom, size_t* out_len) {
    (void)_ctx;
    (void)_user_data;
    char* _buf = (char*)malloc(330);
    if (!_buf) { (void)out_custom; (void)out_len; return 0; }
    snprintf(_buf, 330, "**%s**", (_text ? _text : ""));
    if (out_custom) *out_custom = _buf;
    if (out_len) *out_len = _buf ? strlen(_buf) : 0;
    return 1;
}

int main(void) {

    /* Visitor customizes definition list items */

    HTMHtmVisitorCallbacks _callbacks;
    memset(&_callbacks, 0, sizeof(_callbacks));
    _callbacks.visit_definition_term = c_visitor_visitor_definition_list_custom_visit_definition_term;

    HTMAlefHandle _visitor = htm_visitor_create(&_callbacks);
    assert(_visitor != 0 && "visitor create failed");

    HTMAlefHandle _options = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{}");
    assert(_options != 0 && "options from_json failed");

    htm_options_set_visitor(_options, _visitor);

    HTMAlefHandle _result = htm_convert("<dl><dt>HTML</dt><dd>HyperText Markup Language</dd><dt>CSS</dt><dd>Cascading Style Sheets</dd></dl>", _options);
    assert(_result != 0 && "visitor call failed");

    htm_conversion_result_free(_result);
    htm_conversion_options_free(_options);
    htm_visitor_free(_visitor);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
